name: ai-sdlc
description: Lets non-engineers (HR, marketing, PMs, designers) build and ship small apps with Claude, safely. They describe a problem, agree on examples, and see screenshots before anything goes live. Every change gets a risk tier, riskier changes get an independent Claude engineer review, and only reviewed code merged to main is deployed. Runs on a fixed Nuxt + Cloudflare stack; engineers create apps with /ai-sdlc:new-app and keep them current with /ai-sdlc:update-app.
